y9-11d-q1a.topicTitle: The equation of a straight line
y9-11d-q1a.question: Write down the equation of the line that has gradient \(3\) and \(y\)-intercept \(5\).
y9-11d-q1a.title: Write down the equation of the line that...
y9-11d-q1a.solution:
Using the gradient-intercept form of a straight line:
\(y = mx + c\)
where \(m\) is the gradient and \(c\) is the \(y\)-intercept.

Substituting \(m = 3\) and \(c = 5\):
\(y = 3x + 5\).
y9-11d-q1a.hint: Substitute the gradient for \(m\) and the \(y\)-intercept for \(c\) in \(y = mx + c\).
